notes.title: Monthly report and STEAM SUMMER SALE
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings to all fans of fast cars!
[/h2]
It's here. We too have succumbed to the summer sale madness on STEAM. Currently, Last Holiday is available at a 33% discount as part of the STEAM SUMMER SALE, which runs until July 13. And it's worth it.

As Slávek would say, if you don't buy during the sale, you won't save. That makes sense, doesn't it?

[h2]We're working tirelessly on the game[/h2]
On the day of release, the game wasn't in the best condition. We acknowledge that. But we've worked hard to not disappoint our loyal fans. Since the release, we have released three major patches that fixed numerous bugs and focused on optimization.

What's next? Within the next few weeks, another optimization and bug-fix patch will be released. And then? Then we'll finally start adding content to the game as promised. We already have about 7 additional missions recorded, and we'll gradually release them. Additionally, we'll introduce new gameplay mechanics. You really have something to look forward to. The game will be awesome, that's for sure!

And now, here's a list of fixes, features, and optimizations we added in the past month through three major updates.

[b]Optimizations[/b]
- TLDR: We worked on reducing RAM consumption, resulting in a decrease of 1-5 GB depending on the graphics settings. We also increased draw distance, FPS, and stabilized the game.
- Asynchronous terrain loading
- Simplified house loading
- Balancing of rendering small objects
- Vegetation rendering adjustments

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Smaller items falling through the floor in the garage
- Loading the game erased the left candle
- "Continue" or "Continue in Main Menu" button after death didn't load the latest save
- Saves were not sorted correctly on the LOAD screen
- Fuel tank and arm disappeared after loading the game
- Wheels and wheel caps disappeared after loading the game
- Box with candles disappeared after loading the game
- Player's position was not saved during loading, resulting in appearing at Demeter's place without a tractor
- Occasionally unable to talk to grandpa after delivering groceries to grandma
- Tractor lights not working
- Death in a cutscene caused game bugs
- Death in a tractor caused game bugs
- Could die on top of hay bales while sleeping
- Tire disappeared after mounting the left rear wheel
- Káťa's opening hours have been fixed
- Camera no longer glitches when in the garage or in front of the house
- Grandma no longer levitates
- Driving towards the gas station would sometimes launch cars into the air
- Some shelves in the garage didn't have colliders
- The "Hovnocuc" object didn't have colliders
- Occasionally, after a cutscene before Káťa, Brunova's gang would not despawn
- Piston could be added without a connecting rod
- Exhaust emitted smoke even when not attached to the car
- Hands did not disappear during GAMBA and card games
- Right doors of the tractor wouldn't close
- Headlamp batteries could be inserted even when fully charged
- Trabant doors would launch the player into space
- Stress exclamation mark worked in reverse
- "Game saved" infographic overlapped the pause menu
- The game didn't remember whether it already displayed an EARLY ACCESS message on startup
- Availability of a new JOB with a package was not saved
- If a radio was loaded onto the tractor, it would sink into the ground
- Grandma and grandpa were silent during dialogues in the shopping mission
- Occasionally unable to unpack delivered groceries for grandma
- Turned off motion blur
- Poor lighting in the pub at night
- Front right wheel had incorrect position on the bolts
- Left front doors couldn't be opened after mounting
- Trabant's rear doors occasionally launched the player into space
- Incorrect rotation of rear lights' screws
- Gas bomb couldn't be carried by car
- In some cases, unable to wake up
- In the 7th mission, Trabant's position was loaded incorrectly, requiring the player to run half the map to reach it
- Slávek would bug out in the 7th mission after drinking a can of limči before dialogue
- Incorrect date saving and loading in LOAD and SAVE
- Occasionally, the player would fall under the map when exiting the car
- Grandma lost interaction upon the train's arrival at the station
- Mouse sensitivity during camera rotation while driving is now less frantic
- Blue envelope with a job couldn't be carried by car or tractor
- Some cars had the same license plate
- Lenin disappeared from Slávek's hands in the 7th mission
- Bartender Karel had the wrong description in the subtitles

[b]Newly Added[/b]
- Sheep mission - added tooltip on the map
- Cherry mission - added more cherries
- If an item falls through the floor, it appears at Demeter's junkyard
- Sleep regenerates HP
- Motion blur in the settings
- Mouse inversion in the settings
- Vsync in the settings
- Screen Space global illumination in the settings
- Resetting of glitched tractors, cars, kářka, and tools via posters, with a tooltip for notification
- Tooltip indicating the end of the EARLY ACCESS phase

notes.title: 0.13 - Second Optimization Patch + Fixes + a Few Additions
notes.content:
Optimization:
- We won't beat around the bush, we worked on RAM consumption, and now the resource demand has decreased by 1 - 5 GB depending on the graphic settings.

Bug fixes:
- In some cases, it couldn't wake up.
- In mission 7, the Trabant's position was loading incorrectly, so the player had to run halfway across the map to get to it.
- In mission 7, Slávek bugged out after drinking a can of Limči before the dialogue.
- Incorrect date saving and loading during LOAD and SAVE.
- Occasionally, the player would fall through the map when exiting a vehicle.
- Grandma at the train station lost her interaction upon the train's arrival.
- Mouse sensitivity during camera rotation while driving is now less frantic.
- The blue envelope with Job couldn't be transported by car or tractor.
- Some cars had the same license plate.
- Lenin disappeared from Slávek's hands in mission 7.
- Pub owner Karel had a description of Leon in the subtitles.

New features:
- Motion blur in the settings.
- Mouse inversion in the settings.
- Vsync in the settings.
- Screen Space global illumination in the settings.
- Resetting bugged tractors, cars, carts, and tools through posters, with a tooltip notification.
- Tooltip indicating the end of the Early Access phase.

- Asynchronous terrain loading.
- Simplification of house loading.
- Balancing rendering of small objects.
- Adjustment for rendering vegetation.

notes.title: Bug-fixes patch
notes.content:
Newly added:
•    added tooltip to map in sheep mission
•    added more cherries in the cherry mission
•    if an item falls through the floor, it will appear in Demeter's dump
•    Sleep regenerates HP

Fixes:
•    smaller items were falling through the floor in the garage.
•    LOAD games lubricated the left candle
•    After death, the continue button or the continue button in the main menu did not load the latest SAVE
•    the LOAD screen didn't sort the SAVEs correctly
•    during LOAD game the tank and arm disappeared
•    wheels and wheel caps disappeared when LOADing the game
•    spark plug box disappeared during LOAD
•    player's position was not saved during LOAD, so he could appear at Demeter without the tractor
•    after bringing the groceries to grandma, sometimes it was impossible to talk to grandpa
•    The tractor's lights weren't on.
•    death in a cutscene bugged the game
•    death in the tractor bugged the game
•    it was possible to die to stats while sleeping
•    after mounting the left rear wheel, the tire disappeared
•    Katya's opening hours have been fixed.
•    the camera no longer bugs out when you're in the garage or in front of the house
•    Grandma stopped levitating.
•    The crossing towards the gas station was sending cars into the sky.
•    the shelves in the garage didn't have collider on some of the shelves
•    The poop truck had no colliders.
•    Sometimes after a cutscene, Bruno's gang wouldn't despawn in front of Katya.
•    It was possible to add a piston without a connecting rod.
•    the exhaust smoked even when it wasn't mounted on the car
•    during the hazard games, the hands didn't turn off
•    the tractor's right door wouldn't close
•    the headlamp batteries went in even when fully charged
•    the Trabant door shot the player into space
•    the exclamation point on the stress worked backward
•    the infographic that the game was saved overlaid on the pause menu
•    when starting the game, the game didn't remember if it had already displayed the EARLY ACCES info message
•    it didn't show that there was a new JOB available with a package
•    if a radio was loaded into a tractor, the tractor would sink into the ground
•    Grandma and Grandpa in the shopping mission were quiet in their dialogues
•    sometimes the groceries that were brought to Grandma could not be unpacked.
•    motion blur off
•    the pub was dimly lit at night
•    the right front wheel had the wrong position for the screws
•    the left front door wouldn't open when fitted
•    the rear door of the trabant sometimes shot you into space
•    the taillight screws had the wrong rotation
